headline: 本周影剧：泥面人领跑，夜行杀机首播
summary: 本周电影由《泥面人》领跑，动画、灾难与惊悚新片同步升温；剧集端《夜行杀机》首播，与《侠探杰克》等热播剧同场竞争，待播还有《银翼杀手2099》和《沙丘3》。

industryHighlights.text: 电影端由《泥面人》领跑，动画与灾难惊悚新片共同升温。
industryHighlights.en: On film, Clayface leads as animation, disaster and thriller titles heat up.

industryHighlights.text: 《夜行杀机》本周首播，和《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》等热播剧形成竞争。
industryHighlights.en: Night Kill premieres this week, competing with hot dramas such as Reacher and Crystal Lake.

industryHighlights.text: 待播剧包括《银翼杀手2099》《再婚皇后》《末路兼职》《12 12 12》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming series include Blade Runner 2099, The Remarried Empress, Dead-End Side Hustle and 12 12 12.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影有《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《哥斯拉-0.0》等。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Avengers 5, Dune 3 and Godzilla-0.0.

headlineEn: This Week: Clayface Leads, Night Kill Premieres
summaryEn: This week, Clayface leads the film slate as animation, disaster and thriller titles heat up; on TV, Night Kill premieres and competes with hot dramas like Reacher, with Blade Runner 2099 and Dune 3 also upcoming.
